[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]So they've got a new crown princess.[XENO:n ]
Three cheers for Melia.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Right, but we're still no closer to that[XENO:n ]
murdering faced Mechon.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Once we reach Prison Island,[XENO:n ]
we'll get our chance.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ]
I've seen us there. It must be true.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Maybe we can still persuade big wings?[XENO:wait wait=key ]

Melia's crown princess now, I reckon[XENO:n ]
the Emperor might change his mind.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT16 ]Rein. The Emperor's request was clear.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

There's more to this island than we know.[XENO:n ]
Things are at play here that reach beyond our understanding.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT4 ]That's it! Riki will go see Melia-chan-mo![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT4 ]Old man! Where did that come from?![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT6 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT10 ]Riki hasn't seen Melia-chan for a while-mo.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
Melia-chan must be lonely without Riki too-mo.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT7 ]She might like the distraction.[XENO:n ]
All those stiff ceremonial duties...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT16 ]That's right-mo! Let's go-mo![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
